{{Quote|This isn't glamorous work. We're sanitation workers&mdash;we clean up after the military and the Sith and do the jobs no one else will. Without us, though, the Empire falls apart. So we do whatever is necessary&mdash;even if it's thankless and ugly.|[[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Keeper]], to [[Cipher Nine]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Keeper''' was a senior rank within [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], an arm of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The person holding the rank of the Keeper was in charge of allocating and supervising human resources in the operations division, and answered only to the [[Minister of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Minister of Intelligence]].

==History==
[[File:Watcher_Two_at_Intelligence_HQ.png|thumb|left|The person holding the rank of Keeper during the [[Galactic War]]]]
The Keeper of Imperial Intelligence gave orders to the operatives, oversaw the largest Intelligence operations and was privy to all the secrets of the Empire and Intelligence. Charged with overseeing the [[Operations Division]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], Keeper approved every infiltration into enemy territory and every execution of an enemy of the state. They were responsible for the actions of their agents. But if they failed in the eyes of the [[Minister of Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Minister of Intelligence]] or the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] on the [[Dark Council]], they could be swiftly replaced.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the rank of Keeper was held by a [[Minister of Intelligence (Galactic War)|Human male]]. After he was promoted to the Minister of Intelligence, the rank of Keeper went to a Human female born as [[Shara Jenn]], formerly [[Watcher (Imperial Intelligence)|Watcher]] Two. Unfortunately, Imperial Intelligence was disbanded for series of events that triggered ires of [[Dark Council]]. It would eventually be replaced by [[Sith Intelligence]], with vital ranks being assigned to Sith lords themselves, effectively grounded, if not eliminated Keeper and other imperial ranks.
